name: search_case_studies
description: Lists client case studies, filtered by industry and/or solution. Use it to show past projects or to find the link to a case study. Every filter is optional, partial and case-insensitive.

industry.description: Client industry. One of: Retail, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Energy. Map the user's words to one of these values (for example "varejo" is Retail). Leave empty if unsure.

solution.description: Solution line delivered in the project. One of: Generative AI, Data Platform, Analytics, MLOps, Data Strategy. Leave empty if unsure.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1 to 25, default 10).

name: search_strategic_materials
description: Lists strategic sales materials (sales decks, pitches, first-call decks), filtered by solution and/or tag. Every filter is optional, partial and case-insensitive.

solution.description: Solution line the material is about. One of: Generative AI, Data Platform, Analytics, MLOps, Data Strategy. Leave empty if unsure.

tag.description: Free-text tag, matched partially. Examples: first-call, sales-deck, pitch, databricks.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1 to 25, default 10).

name: search_support_materials
description: Lists support materials (ROI calculators, proposal templates, one-pagers, questionnaires), filtered by solution and/or a free-text query over the title and description. Every filter is optional, partial and case-insensitive.

solution.description: Solution line the material supports. One of: Generative AI, Data Platform, Analytics, MLOps, Data Strategy. Leave empty if unsure.

query.description: Free text matched partially against title and description. Examples: ROI, proposal, one-pager.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1 to 25, default 10).
